coordinate_convention.heading: outward; 0 degrees north, clockwise in plan view
coordinate_convention.slope: outward rise/run at the edge; percent = 100 * grade

piece.purpose: Authoritative build definition and permanent game-resource identity for DD RHW-4 — Upper Diagonal Entry Branch.
piece.name: DD RHW-4 — Upper Diagonal Entry Branch
piece.description: Reusable upper entry branch component of the compact diagonal double-decker highway and Avenue interchange. Place its owned tiles exactly as shown in the assembly guide; traffic uses actual car and pedestrian PATHs.

provenance.geometry: Measured native DD RHW-4 and Avenue channels with authored compact ramps.
provenance.construction: Reviewed exclusive tile partition; four proper rotations repeated.
provenance.partition_review: Reviewed one-diagonal-tile ramp extension and right-turn-only access. Retains piece, puzzle, menu, preview, and reserved resource-block identities; local model slots follow the revised AutoTileBase grid. Native MIS materials replace the flat atlas.

connections.purpose: Intrinsic saved-resource endpoints, service roles, directed journeys, and forbidden transfers for one piece.

source.scope: one piece only; no counterpart catalogue is consulted
source.construction_basis: Actual emitted per-piece rule sections from the independently verified saved build
